strings.subtitle: — Muparadzi wefaira —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kuzvuta nekusiya hazviripo. Shandisa bhatani riri pasi.
strings.shred_button: P A R A D Z A
strings.ssd_warning:
Yambiro! Pa SSD nzira yekunyora pamusoro haivimbisi kuparadza nekuda kweTRIM.
Chirongwa ichi ndecheHDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Faira "{name}" richanyorwa pamusoro uye richadzimwa.

Enderera?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Iyi ishortcut (.lnk). Shortcut chete ndiyo ichaparadzwa.

Faira yainonongedzera icharamba iri nani.

Enderera mberi?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Iyi inetwork drive (\\server\share).
Kunyora pamusoro pezvikamu hakuvimbisi kuparadza — server inogona kunge iine masnapshot, deduplication kana CoW.

Enderera mberi?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Iyi inoremovable drive (USB / HDD yekunze).
Controller inogona kuchengeta mabhuroko ekare mureserve.

Enderera mberi?
strings.report_limits:
• Nzira dzedzimwe data dzeNTFS (ADS) hadzishandiswe.
• Bhuku reUSN haricheneswi.
• Makopi emumvuri nekuenderana kwemakore
  (OneDrive nezvimwe) hazvikanganiswe.
strings.status_full: Zviri mukati zvakanyorwa pamusoro zvizere neziro. Kudzorerwa hakugoneki — maturusi anoona ziro chete.
strings.status_fast: Musoro, muswe nemitsetse 4 MB yakanyorwa pamusoro. Zvasara hazvina kubatwa, asi nekuda kwemikaha, kudzoreredza kuzere nematurusi evashandisi hakugoneki. Kune magwaro akavanzika shandisa mutoo WAKAZARA.
strings.status_empty: Faira rakanga risina chinhu, kunyora pamusoro kwaisafanira. Rakadzimwa.
strings.error_permission: Haisakwanise kusvika pafaira. Inogona kunge yakavhurwa mune chimwe chirongwa. Vhara uye edza zvakare.
strings.error_not_found: Faira harina kuwanikwa. Rinogona kunge rakabviswa kare.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi isymbolic link. Ma links haakwanise kuparadzwa — faira yainonongedzera icharamba iri nani.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ipafaira rekuisa (OneDrive kana zvakafanana). Data raro rakachengetwa mugore, kwete padiski — hapana chekuparadza pano.
strings.error_not_file: Iri harisi faira (folda kana chimwe chinhu). Donhedza faira.
strings.error_hardlinks: Faira iri rine mamwe ma hard link ({n} ose). Ma hard link haana wekutanga — mazita ese akaenzana. Kana ukaparadza nenzira yazvino, data ichanyorwa pamusoro uye kuchekwa kusvika 32 bytes, asi iyo stub icharamba ichiwanikwa kuburikidza nemamwe ma link. Bvisa ma link ese kutanga.
strings.error_compressed:
Faira rakadzvanywa, rakavharwa kana kushomeka. Kunyora zero hakuvimbisi kuparadza data rekare nekuti NTFS inozvichengeta nenzira yakasiyana.

Bvisa hunhu: tinya kurudyi → Zvivakwa → Zvakawedzera → bvisa 'Dzvanya' uye/kana 'Vhara'. Wobva wamhanyisa SHREDDER zvakare.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Mafaira {count} achaparadzwa.
Ukuru hwose: {size}.

Tarisa rondedzero usati waenderera mberi.
Chiito ichi hachigone kudzoserwa shure.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Bvisa mafaira ese {count} kubva mumutsetse?

Mafaira pachawo HAASI kuzobatwa — rondedzero chete.
strings.hardlink_text:
Faira "{name}" rine mamwe ma hard link ({nlink} ose).

Data ichaparadzwa kumazita ese.
Asi zvakasara (32 bytes) zvicharamba zviri pasi pemamwe mazita mufolda.

Ungangoda kubvisa zvakasara izvi nemaoko.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Shandisa kune ese ma hard link mumutsetse
